title: Reward Passes: our new progression mechanic, explained
body:
# Reward Passes: our new progression mechanic, explained

Raiders,

Frozen Trail launches on October 8, bringing with it a new progression system called the Reward Pass. Below is a full breakdown of how this system works and what the two Passes arriving with Frozen Trail will offer.

# What is a Reward Pass?

Reward Passes build on the foundation of Raider Decks, with extra advantages layered in. This progression system lets players complete Feats to unlock rewards tied to the Frozen Trail update, including outfits, cosmetic items, gadgets, weapons, items, and Raider Tokens.

# An evolution of Raider Decks

Raider Decks served as a solid foundation, but issues emerged over time. Cred piled up faster than players could spend it. As a result, whenever a new Raider Deck launched, plenty of players had already saved enough Cred to clear it almost immediately. That undercut how rewarding the system felt, and it removed much of the incentive to keep working through Feats.

Reward Passes are designed to fix this by creating a progression path that stays engaging over a longer stretch of time. Each Reward Pass is linked to the update it launches alongside, so every player gets the chance to experience new content, items, and weapons simply by playing.

# Frozen Trail: Reward Passes

Two Reward Passes will be available when Frozen Trail launches: the Frozen Trail Reward Pass and the Legacy Reward Pass.

The **Frozen Trail Pass** spans 60 levels and comes in both Free and Premium versions.

* Free Pass – This includes every new base outfit, along with additional cosmetic items, weapons, gadgets, items, and up to 200 Raider Tokens in total.

* Premium Pass – This version adds more value. It unlocks all premium toggles, modifications, and colorways for the new outfits, plus exclusive legendary weapon stencils and hairstyles, along with up to 1,150 Raider Tokens total. Two important notes: unlike the Free Pass, the Premium Pass does not include gameplay items such as weapons or gadgets. Also, the Premium Pass itself costs 1,150 Raider Tokens, meaning full completion effectively refunds the currency spent to unlock it.

The **Legacy Pass** consolidates every cosmetic reward and Raider Token previously found across all Raider Decks into one single Free Pass. Anything already earned in the past stays unlocked within the Legacy Reward Pass. Progressing through this Pass will otherwise grant any rewards from the old Raider Deck system that you missed.

# Frozen Trail Collector Set DLC

For Raiders after the complete Frozen Trail package, the Collector Set DLC includes a new cosmetic set called the Renzo, the Dragon's Breath Weapon Stencil, the Bob Hair Style, and 2,400 Raider Tokens. It also unlocks access to the Frozen Trail Premium Reward Pass.

On top of that, the Collector Set includes an exclusive Retro Sofa for your Raider Outpost, and it is the only source for the blueprint of the new Banjo musical instrument.

The Collector Set DLC is available now on Steam, where you can browse all included cosmetics and rewards.

Whichever way you choose to play through the Frozen Trail Update, we hope this new system makes your progression feel exciting and worthwhile.

See you Topside,

The ARC Raiders Team
